_about: Raman's OWN attention per worked chart, from Notable Horoscopes. The target is EXPERT ATTENTION, never life outcomes — this sits clear of the astrobank firewall and does not relitigate the measured-null generalization axis.
_split: deterministic: usable charts sorted by name, alternating tune/holdout. Frozen before any salience model existed or any score was seen.
_usable_rule: printed lat+long (castable) AND at least one emphasised factor

_trivial_baselines._why: Raman genuinely emphasises Lagna, the 10th and the 9th most often, so a constant guess already scores well. A salience model that does not BEAT these numbers has demonstrated nothing.

_caveat: n is small. Every number computed against this benchmark must be reported with a confidence interval, and a difference inside the interval is not a result.
